reference_decisions.draw_contract: caller supplies an independent uniform integer in [0,candidate_count) for every actual draw; vectors inject indexes; no draw for empty candidates or full board
reference_decisions.reference_weight_policy: uniform per eligible instance or card ID; original server weights are unknown
reference_decisions.input_board: friendly/enemy are the current board after trigger removal; if the source remains in friendly, caller supplies source_id for other-than-source filtering
reference_decisions.pool_stock: independent of shop stock; summon draws with replacement; all generated minions are combat-only
reference_decisions.summon_order: one request at a time until seven slots fill; requests count remains card-face count even when fewer are placed
reference_decisions.board_random_target: uniform among current eligible instances, re-evaluated after each local action
reference_decisions.shield_eligibility: Selfless Hero skips instances already bearing Divine Shield; this is a reference choice, not original evidence
reference_decisions.damage: single-event reference damage consumes Divine Shield or reduces health and removes a dead target before the next hit; other queued death effects are outside this resolver
reference_decisions.tribe_overlap: card-face tribe order; each tribe independently samples once, so an ALL instance may receive several buffs
reference_decisions.iron_sensei: leftmost other friendly MECHANICAL or ALL instance; the card face does not say random
reference_decisions.zerus: caller emits held_round_tick while card is in hand; random replacement preserves normal/golden form, excluding BGS_029 itself
reference_decisions.discover: three distinct options per offer from MURLOC-or-ALL rows, independent offers for golden form, caller chooses an option; full hand still exposes choice but cannot acquire
reference_decisions.adapt: three distinct options per offer from ten listed client entities; golden makes two independent offers and may repeat an option between offers; both choices apply to one initial friendly MURLOC-or-ALL snapshot
reference_decisions.empty_candidates: skip that local request, without drawing or silently choosing another pool
reference_decisions.simultaneous_deaths: fail closed; no historical or reference ordering asserted for a batch
